predecessors.name: County of Toulouse
predecessors.text: Joan's lands in the Comtat Venaissin, held by Alphonse, Count of Poitiers and Toulouse, and 'bequeathed to the Holy See on his death in 1271'

successors.name: Kingdom of France
successors.text: the Comtat, annexed by the plebiscite of 14 September 1791 ('Reversed into France by plebiscite'); the Vaucluse department was made from it a few years later

ledger.x: 1274: the Comtat Venaissin becomes a papal territory.
1320: the capital moves from Venasque to Carpentras.
The page lists 1663 only and gives no end, so the occupation is bridged as lasting that year; the Comtat stayed papal.
1668: French troops occupy the Comtat again.
The page lists 1668 only and gives no end; bridged as that year.
14 September 1791: the Comtat votes to join France.

wars.name: French occupations of the Comtat Venaissin
wars.outcome: Three French invasions (1663, 1668 and 1768-1774) that each ended with the Comtat back under papal rule, until the plebiscite of 14 September 1791 gave it to France.

certainty.note: No page opened gives a treaty or survey line for the Comtat's frontier with Provence, Orange and the Dauphine; the 8-10 cell shape is approximate throughout.
